trans-unit.source: Writes the indexing events of EXT:index into the ke_search index of this site.
Write the indexing events of EXT:index into the ke_search index for this site.
Page uid of the folder the index records are stored in ("pid" column of tx_kesearch_index). Use a dedicated folder that is not used by any ke_search indexer configuration. Required.
Page uid the search results of files and external documents link to (usually the search result page). ke_search rejects records without a target page, so this value is required.
Value of the "type" column for indexed pages. "page" makes ke_search link to the page uid. Change it only if you need an own result type.
Value of the "type" column for documents without a page or FAL file (external pages and remote files). "external" makes ke_search link to the stored URI.
Optional uid of a ke_search filter option (tx_kesearch_filteroptions). Its tag is added to every document of this bridge, which allows filtering the results by source.
Convert the keywords of a page into ke_search tags.
Remove outdated documents after a full index run

Delete all documents of the storage folder that have not been written again during a full EXT:index run. Only enable this if the storage folder is used exclusively by this bridge and all EXT:index configurations of the site are executed together.
